comparison.objective: Set and retain a robot-gripper stop versus seal, shake, and reopen a cocktail shaker without spilling.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires precision hex/wrench seating and countertorque; shaker versions require press-fit sealing, two-hand dynamic shaking, spill control, and separation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks angle tolerance, nut retention, and repeatable actuation; shaker versions check sealed shaking/mixing, retained contents, upright placement, and in the latest version reopening.
comparison.reason: All six available specifications concern dynamic vessel handling rather than adjustable mechanical locking.
